chunks: It is He who prevails over His creatures, and He is all-wise and aware.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah is 'Al-Qahir' (The Prevailing) over His creatures?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-An'am underscores Allah's absolute transcendence (Tanzih), where 'Al-Qahir' denotes His overpowering authority that subjugates all creation, while 'Al-Hakim' and 'Al-Khabir' affirm His precise wisdom and intimate knowledge of every detail. This triad of attributes reinforces the concept of divine omnipotence coupled with omniscience, serving as a foundation for understanding how God's will governs both the cosmic order and individual destinies.
